card.line: Cana was a town in Galilee where Jesus did His first sign, turning water into wine, and where He later healed an official's son.

moments.title: Water Into Wine
moments.text: At a wedding in Cana, the wine ran out. Jesus had servants fill stone jars with water, and it became fine wine. This was the first of His signs, and His disciples believed in Him.

moments.title: A Royal Official's Son Healed
moments.text: A royal official came to Jesus at Cana and begged Him to heal his son, who was about to die at Capernaum. Jesus said, "Your son will live," and the boy was healed.

moments.title: Nathanael's Hometown
moments.text: Nathanael, one of the disciples, was from Cana in Galilee. He was with Peter and others when Jesus showed Himself by the Sea of Tiberias.
